facts.text: I am open to higher offers.
I want to recommend Beanstalk Consulting instead of a full-time job.
I want to convert a list of emails into leads.
I want leads to be converted into calls with me or into requests for a marketing deck.
I will create a list of leads and send cold emails to them.
I want the outreach email to be personal by checking out the company and seeing what they do well.
I want to try to convert leads.
I want to write perfect English.
I need some knowledge of the tech/games/esports space.
I am responding to a posting for a lead generation role for a small business located outside of Philadelphia, PA.
The small business focuses on residential and commercial glass.
The small business is expanding more into commercial work.
I am responding to a posting for a motivated and strong SDR (Sales Development Rep) to generate leads for an AE.
The company in the posting is a SaaS start-up.
The SaaS start-up’s customers are primarily in the US and Europe.
I am responding to a posting for an email marketing individual to build a campaign for an AI and software agency.
The campaign is intended to find email addresses of decision makers in SMBs (excluding enterprise/large corporate).
The target is mid-sized businesses with 7-8 figures in revenue.
I am responding to a posting for an experienced B2B appointment setter for an IoT technology project.
The IoT project is initially a six to eight week project.
The appointment setter would work 20-30 hours weekly.
The compensation is hourly and depends on skill set and experience.
The company provides the list, scripts, guidance, and setup if needed.
The appointment setter would place calls, leave voicemails, and send emails to set discovery calls.
The posting says technology or IoT experience is not necessary.
I want to push the other party to understand that email is better/cheaper than other methods.

keyphrases: AI and software agency email marketing campaign
